text:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime p95/p99 anomaly detected for /v1/stream.generate (eu-1). p99 ≈ 4.1s (3.2x baseline), threshold breached. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/streams/alerts/4555 :rotating_light:
megan_oncall: ack — oncall megan here. starting quick triage. linking runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.example/latency/initial-triage
alex_runtime: seeing same on graphs. spike starts ~+00:02 from now, coincides with a small rollout to eu-1 pool ~1m ago (kvrouting v2).
shiv_sre: first checks: kvcache hitrate, GPU queue latency, network egress, and recent route table changes. also check streaming ingress throttles.
kirill_eng: I'll check kvcache metrics. preliminary: prefix_hit_rate eu-1 dropped from 92% -> 67% over 2m. eviction count spiked.
megan_oncall: customer-impact quick check? ps_team, any active alerts from customers?
ps_team: one enterprise customer reported multiple stalled streams ~1:02. only observed in eu region so far. about ~10 sessions affected.
alex_runtime: logs show repeated 'kv_cache_miss' and backlog flush warnings. sample log: `WARN stream: kv_cache_miss key=usr:prfx:... latency=312ms`
shiv_sre: mitigation plan: (1) route-shift 20% traffic to eu-2 pool, (2) increase worker concurrency on eu-1 airsonic nodes, (3) rollback kvrouting v2 if quick fix fails.
megan_oncall: executing route-shift now. command: `./ops traffic-shift --from eu-1 --to eu-2 --percent 20`
megan_oncall: route-shift command issued — monitor for p99 drop.
alex_runtime: after shift p99 down to ~2.0s (still above SLO but improving). kvcache hitrate in eu-1 unchanged yet.
kirill_eng: pushing tiny config bump to increase kvcache entries (safe), patch in flight: `kubectl set env deploy/stream -n eu NODE_CACHE_MAX=512`
ps_team: keeping customers updated. sending note to affected accounts with ETA ~15m while we monitor.
shiv_sre: asking to check autoscaler events: `kubectl get hpa -n eu | grep stream` -> shows no unexpected scale events.
megan_oncall: if p99 doesn't drop under 1.5s in 10m, prepare rollback of kvrouting v2. I'll keep this channel updated and escalate to eng-leads if customer impact widens. :point_up:
alex_runtime: adding a quick synthetic check: `curl -sS https://perf.redwood.example/stream_probe?region=eu-1` -> results showing intermittent 5-8s tails on a subset of requests.
megan_oncall: next actions: continue monitor, complete kvcache config bump, keep 20% route-shift, PS customer comms. oncall will remain in channel.
incident-bot: NOTE: paging timer set for 10m if SLO not recovered. playbooks: latency -> https://runbooks.redwood.example/latency/mitigate
megan_oncall: thanks team — keeping this as live thread. will post summary when stable or escalated. :white_check_mark:
